subject: Finalize package for Senior Infrastructure Engineer - expedited signoff needed
messages:
From: Ryan Moore <ryan.moore@gmail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing package for Senior Infra Eng - timing

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — I'm excited about Redwood and the team. I wanted to be candid: I received a competing written offer this morning from TechCorp with a 2-week acceptance window. The base is $220,000 with a $25k sign-on and slightly different equity. I prefer Redwood, but they require an answer by Nov 20 EOD PST.

Is there any way to accelerate the final paperwork? If you can get an updated package over in the next 48 hours, I can prioritize Redwood and delay TechCorp. Attaching the TechCorp offer for reference.

Best,
Ryan
--
Ryan Moore
Senior Infrastructure Engineer (candidate)
ryan.moore@gmail.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Comp exception request: Ryan Moore (Senior Infra) — competing offer, deadline Nov 20

Laura / Karthik —

Quick context: Ryan (candidate) just shared a competing written offer with a tight deadline (Nov 20 EOD PST). He prefers Redwood but needs an improved package to sign. Current IC band for Senior Infra: base $180k-$200k, target equity 0.25%–0.5%, sign-on guideline $10k for market exceptions.

His ask (informal): match TechCorp base ($220k) or get within ~$10k + $25k sign-on. My recommended path to close fast:
- One-time band exception: base -> $210,000
- Sign-on: $20,000 (payable over first 2 payrolls)
- Equity: 0.45% with 4-year vesting (traditional schedule)
- Standard start date 2027-01-10

Can we push a headcount/comp exception approval through today? If approved, I will send an updated offer and DocuSign link with a Nov 22 deadline (we need a little breathing room). I can also mark this as "sales-urgency" style close but for hiring.

Attached is a completed comp_band_exception_form.xlsx (filled) for payroll/finance.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: comp_band_exception_form.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Comp exception request: Ryan Moore — suggestion

Jonas / Chloe —

Thanks for the fast turnaround on details. Two quick thoughts:
1) Base to $210k plus $20k sign-on is within stretch but still preferable to doing full $220k given internal equity discipline.
2) If we approve, I want to limit the sign-on clawback (6 months prorated) and confirm that this hire does not set a band precedent — mark as one-off approved by VP.

Operational ask for you: can you confirm the expected total OTE-ish first-year cash spend and the GL code for sign-on so I can fast-track the finance ticket?

If both Karthik and I are aligned, we should escalate to Markus for final signoff (VP of Eng comp approvals). I'll loop him now.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Approval request: one-time comp-band exception for Ryan Moore (Senior Infra Eng)

Hi Markus —

Requesting your signoff for a one-time comp-band exception to close a high-priority candidate. Summary:
- Candidate: Ryan Moore (external)
- Role: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (IC3)
- Current band: $180k-$200k
- Proposed: base $210,000 + sign-on $20,000 + equity 0.45%
- Rationale: competing written offer (TechCorp) with acceptance deadline Nov 20. Candidate prefers Redwood; high technical fit for infra/runtime team; slow hiring means we risk losing him without a fast package.

If approved, Talent Ops will draft the offer with a DocuSign deadline of Nov 22 EOD PST to give us time for paperwork. Finance has pre-cleared the sign-on account (GL 4312) if you approve.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to discuss.

Thanks,
Laura

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: one-time comp-band exception for Ryan Moore

Laura / team —

Approved with conditions:
- Base $210,000 as proposed.
- Sign-on $20,000 with a 6-month prorated clawback clause.
- Equity 0.45% (no change to vesting schedule).
- Offer should include standard new-hire protections (90-day performance review clause removed) and a 30-day extension option if candidate requests more time.

Please mark this as a one-off exception tied to requisition REQ-1789 and include a short memo in HR-4521 summarizing the rationale for audit. Laura, please proceed to generate the offer and DocuSign link; Jonas, send to candidate once ready.

-Markus

Date: 2026-11-19T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Official offer — Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Redwood)

Hi Ryan —

Really pleased to share the official offer package for Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Redwood Inference. Thank you for your patience while we worked through approvals — everyone rallied to move quickly. Key terms summarized below (full offer attached / DocuSign link included):

- Base salary: $210,000 per year
- Sign-on bonus: $20,000 (paid over first 2 payrolls; subject to 6-month prorated clawback)
- Equity: 0.45% RSU equivalent, 4-year standard vesting
- Target start date: January 10, 2027 (flexible)
- Benefits: standard Redwood benefits, relocation stipend available on request

We are asking for signature by Nov 22, 2026 EOD PST to respect the competing offer timeline; if you need a short extension, let me know and we'll consider up to Nov 24.

Next steps: I attached the full offer PDF and a DocuSign link (https://app.docusign.com/ABC-Offer-RyanMoore). Please review and ping me if you want to talk through any line items — happy to jump on a quick call today.

Warmly,
Jonas
